definition.universe: the nightly persisted universe: the top 50 names BY CONVICTION of the 250 fetched, written to signals.csv each night, of which a median 43 are priced on both nights of a leg and form the equal-weight control. NOT the live board, which scores ~234 — and selected on conviction, which is the variable any edge measured over it is about.
definition.gate_note: No qualification gate was ever applied to this book. _perf_by_date reads price and conviction only; no gate flag is persisted. On the first night of the current specification zero names passed gates A and B and the book still held ten.
definition.weights: prior night, priced at both ends
definition.unpriced_rule: a name with no price on the later night is renormalised away; a leg losing more than 10% of its book is excluded
definition.survivorship_note: the universe is re-cut at the top 50 nightly, so a name that falls out of it is renormalised rather than booked. Latent: no usable leg on this ledger has lost any weight to it.

decomposition.basis: A = score-weighted Top-10; B = the same ten names, equal weight; C = the nightly persisted universe (50 names, median 43 priced on both nights), equal weight; D = BTC. A-B = weighting effect; B-C = selection effect versus the nightly 50-name opportunity set; A-C = total active effect versus that set. C is NOT the ~234-name live board. All four are chained over the same usable legs from the same price endpoints; B is exact, the same selection under the same missing-name rule.

stats.inference_note: 47 overnight legs cannot establish a residual effect, and cannot establish its absence either. The sign is stable across resampling schemes; the interval is not: a Newey-West t near 1.252 and a block-bootstrap 95% interval that includes zero under the short-block specification. Reported as WEAK / NOT ESTABLISHED.

contribution.weights: prior-night target weights, renormalised over priced names

nights.basis: shares of the arithmetic sum of nightly returns, not of the chained total

edge.verdict: Conviction orders the universe backwards — the ranking is inverted.
edge.universe: signals.csv — the top fifty by conviction, each night

basket_note: EXPERIMENTAL / NON-CANONICAL. The fields latest, basket_*, benchmark_*, exec_adjusted_*, risk, current_holdings, latest_holdings and rows describe build_basket()'s hysteresis basket, benchmarked to total crypto market cap. The Index is `canonical`.
sharpe_convention: DEPRECATED - not displayed. rf=0; daily x sqrt(365); 34 days is not a sample
